narrative.overview: Runwake is quiet, dense, and stable. Important controls hold their position while runtime evidence updates in place, with expression coming from precision rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Stable control positions and in-place state changes.
Dense evidence with clear hierarchy and progressive disclosure.
Monospace reserved for runtime data, paths, commands, and measurements.
Blue for action or selection; semantic colors for operational state.
Borders and tonal layers establish structure without decorative chrome.

rules.name: Signal Economy
rules.body: Accent and semantic colors indicate action, selection, or operational state; they are never background decoration.

rules.name: Data Earns Mono
rules.body: Use monospace only where character alignment, exact copying, or machine syntax matters.

rules.name: Fixed Position
rules.body: State changes update content and signals in place; they do not move the operator's next action.

rules.name: Evidence Stays Flat
rules.body: Logs, tables, settings rows, and connection registries do not use shadows.

dos: Do make common actions visible and keep advanced controls one deliberate reveal away.
Do preserve the user's place when live data arrives or a filter changes.
Do show exact counts, active filters, and recovery paths.
Do make every state and action reachable by keyboard.
donts: Don't structure a page as a gallery of equal-weight cards.
Don't use accent colors as decoration or monospace as a technical costume.
Don't replace evidence with invented diagnoses or persist browser-only log workbench state.
Don't move, resize, or blank a working region during an in-place refresh.
